seo.title: openIndu Community | The End-to-End Open-Source OS for Industrial Automation
seo.description: From process parameters to line data — one stack, end to end. AI-assisted, full-chain industrial control development (electrical → BOM → I/O → PLC/HMI), cross-brand code generation, industrial IoT data acquisition, and yield analysis. Any brand PLC, fully open source under Apache-2.0.
seo.keywords: openIndu,industrial automation,open source,PLC,HMI,cross-brand,electrical design,BOM,I/O address table,industrial IoT,PLC4X,OEE,yield analysis,custom automation

products.heading: Three Core Projects
products.subheading: All Apache-2.0 open source, spanning the complete loop from process knowledge to production insight

studio.description: An AI-assisted, full-chain industrial control development toolchain. Electrical modules → circuit diagrams → BOM → I/O address tables → PLC programs → HMI screens — one tool per step, multi-brand output.

platform.description: An industrial IoT platform unifying device connectivity, data acquisition, line monitoring, and product traceability. Protocol layer built on Apache PLC4X, covering S7, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, and OPC-UA. Edge computing enabled via openIndu-cim.

station.description: A C# industrial station-control application. Motion control · machine vision · barcode scanning · dispensing · laser — the software foundation for custom automation stations.

nodes.heading: The Five-Stage Closed Loop
nodes.subheading: Process constraints → Generation → Execution → Data → Insight → back to process constraints

openSourceEndToEnd.title: Open Source End to End
